title: The First Morning — Decisive Victory
description: Sixty-point-seven percent. The constitution is read into the parliamentary record at nine o'clock. The morning edition headline is a single word: 'MANDATE.' Now you have to govern like you earned it.

title: Certification Pending — Narrow Win
description: Fifty-one-point-eight percent. Seventeen days of legal review ahead. Kolvar's people are combing precinct returns for irregularities. You won, but he's making you win twice.

title: Cabinet at Nine — Referendum Lost
description: Forty-six-point-three percent. Only five ministers confirmed attendance. Dusek arrived in uniform — a signal, whether she intended one or not. The question is no longer about the constitution.

title: Budget Allocation — Post-Referendum Adjustment
description: The referendum result changes the fiscal picture. Victory means implementation costs. Defeat means political crisis spending. Either way, Vostane needs numbers by end of week.

title: Cabinet Session — Government Direction
description: The full cabinet convenes for the first time since the referendum. Some faces are the same. Some are calculating whether they'd survive a confidence vote. All of them are watching you.

title: Foreign Policy — Arcturian Reassessment
description: Ambassador Cole's office has been unusually quiet. Three meeting requests unanswered. The quarterly trade talks have been postponed without explanation. Someone in Stellamere is recalculating.
